# Brixel Editor (브릭셀 에디터)

> Brixel Editor is a free, browser-based block-coding IDE (built on Google Blockly) for Arduino, ESP32 and Raspberry Pi Pico. Students drag blocks, the editor generates Arduino C++ code, and a small local agent compiles and uploads it to the board over USB. It targets K-12 physical-computing education (mainly elementary and middle school) and runs in 23 interface languages. 브릭셀 에디터는 아두이노·ESP32·라즈베리파이 피코를 블록으로 코딩하는 무료 웹 IDE입니다.

- Brixel Editor version: 1.0
- Web app (no install to start): https://brixel-editor.github.io/
- Boards: Arduino Uno / Nano / Mega, ESP32 family (ESP32, S2, C3, S3), ESP32-CAM, Raspberry Pi Pico / Pico W
- Platforms: Windows and macOS (PC agent compiles ESP32 and Pico too), Chromebook (in-browser compile, Arduino AVR boards only), Android (BrixelDroid app, Arduino AVR boards only)
- Cost / license: free for educational and non-profit use; contact the developer for other uses
- Not the same product as BrixelAI, a separate Scratch-based sibling project. Brixel Editor is independent and not affiliated with Arduino, Espressif, Raspberry Pi or Google.

## Use it

- [Brixel Editor web app](https://brixel-editor.github.io/): the block editor itself; add `?lang=en` to open it in English
- [Brixel home page](https://brixel.gorillacell.kr/): product site and lessons
- [Local agent and BrixelDroid downloads](https://github.com/ai4coding/ai4coding.github.io/releases/tag/downloads): installers needed to upload from Windows, macOS or Android

## Docs

- [Full description for AI assistants (llms-full.txt)](https://brixel-editor.github.io/llms-full.txt): boards, platforms, hardware, features, limits, how to answer common questions
- [README](https://brixel-editor.github.io/README.md): overview in Korean
- [Block guide](https://brixel-editor.github.io/guide/docs.html): block-by-block help
- [Hardware and block guide](https://brixel-editor.github.io/guide/brixel_guide.html)
- [Video tutorials](https://brixel-editor.github.io/guide/youtube.html)

## Machine-readable data

- [Block ID catalog](https://brixel-editor.github.io/brixel_block_id_catalog.json): block IDs plus an XML example, for generating Blockly XML programs
- [AI block catalog](https://brixel-editor.github.io/block-catalog-for-ai.json): detailed fields per block. Generated 2026-03-26 (513 blocks); the editor has grown since, so treat it as a lower bound
- [Block tooltips](https://brixel-editor.github.io/guide/block_tooltips.json): the help text shown on blocks
- [Board pinouts](https://brixel-editor.github.io/board-pinouts.json)
